nodes.label: Dubbing Studio Page (clone voice, swap words, re-lip-sync)
nodes.rationale: 3-step flow: transcribe locally → edit script (kept near original length for natural lip-sync) → dub with local engine (XTTS v2 + Wav2Lip/GFPGAN, free) or fal.ai cloud (F5/MiniMax voice + LatentSync/MuseTalk/VEED/sync-v2 lips); paid runs require an explicit cost-approval confirm before anything is charged. Endpoints: /api/overview, /api/script/{stem}, /api/run, /api/job/{id}, /api/upload.

nodes.label: XTTS v2 Local Voice Cloning
nodes.rationale: Clones the speaker's voice and speaks the new script on the local GPU — no network, no cost; the free default against the paid fal.ai voice models.

nodes.label: fal.ai Cloud Pipeline (paid TTS + lip-sync tiers)
nodes.rationale: Paid cloud alternative: F5/MiniMax voices and LatentSync (~$0.20/40s), MuseTalk, VEED (~$0.40/min), sync v2 (~$3/min), sync v2 PRO lip-sync tiers. Every UI path forces an explicit 'approve cost' confirmation before spending, and running spend is tracked and surfaced per job.

nodes.label: GFPGAN Face Restorer (HD sharpening for Wav2Lip)
nodes.rationale: Sharpens the soft Wav2Lip mouth region to make the free local pipeline 'HD'; CodeFormer offered as an identity-faithful alternative in DubSync Repair.
